card.name: Wording that qualifies dose adjustments
card.fires_on: Small qualifying words in dosing instructions, such as "certain" before drug classes, or "reduced", "as", "based on" and "according to" in dose-change phrases. It fires on the word right before the specific condition, drug group or table that defines the adjustment.

modes.label: "certain" before drug groups
modes.description: The word "certain" or the word after it, naming only some drugs or foods.
modes.example: 2.5 mg when used concomitantly with<< certain>> CYP3A4 inhibitors

modes.label: Dose-change phrasing
modes.description: Words like reduced, as, or based on that lead into how a dose is changed.
modes.example: Withhold or reduce the dose of BLENREP based<< on>> severity

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "specified", "prescribed", "certain" and "mandated", which point to a defined condition or rule.
card.plain: It marks the linking words in dosing text that say the dose depends on a certain condition or drug.
